FN-6YJRJ3Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 74
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chad Robertson
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 74 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain local law enforcement
agencies by: (1) an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to provide a retiring law
enforcement officer their badge as part of their retirement benefits, who would not otherwise
receive their badge at retirement; and (2) an estimated $1,000 to allow the agency to provide a
retiring law enforcement officer their agency-issued pistol as part of their retirement benefits,
who would not otherwise receive their pistol at retirement. This bill would also increase receipts
of certain law enforcement agencies by an undetermined amount depending on the fair market
value of the pistol sold to the retiring officer.
